info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Careers Applications Jobs-v4-spec
info.description: The Job Listings Retrieval API enables users to access current job openings within the careers applications system. It provides a comprehensive list of available positions, including essential details such as job titles, descriptions, and requirements. This API is particularly useful for job seekers who are exploring new career opportunities or for organizations wishing to display available roles. Developers can integrate this functionality into career platforms, recruitment websites, or HR management systems.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of job applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all job applications submitted to the system. You can use various query parameters to filter the results based on specific criteria.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve job applications. It should contain the necessary parameters required for filtering or querying the job applications.
